shared_elements: figure holding an upright staff-like object
low-relief single dominant figure filling the panel
justification: Both show a single elaborately dressed standing dignitary in low relief, in profile with a tall headdress and gripping a vertical staff-like implement, filling a framed rectangular field. However the conventions differ sharply: A is spare, linear and anatomically restrained with a plain fluted crown, beard and simple robe, while B is densely packed with ornament, masks, beaded pectorals, plumes and blocks of glyph-like signs plus a basal band, leaving little empty ground.
